subject: Bring in Human Taste for AI Content Moderation
text:
Hi [NAME],

Came across your youtube video on modernizing [COMPANY]'s content
moderation in [YEAR]. Really compelling work using SageMaker Serverless to
handle UGC at scale.

As AI-generated reviews become harder to distinguish from appropiate
authentic ones, the pipeline faces a new challenge your current classifiers
weren't built for.

We've been working with frontier labs on red teaming and content
moderation, and think this is the next moat for teams like yours knowing
what's human vs AI-generated across your clients' UGC use cases.

We offer an annotation suite that combines LLMs and human review to build
that taste into your models, at the per-client specificity your
architecture already supports.

Open to a quick chat later this week?

P.S. My wife went to Masterman i'm in Philly regularly, hope you enjoy it
too!

*-[SENDER]*

subject: Encord + 3D scan data - relevant to [COMPANY]'s ML pipeline?
text:
Hi [NAME],

I came across [COMPANY]'s work on FitTech; impressive what you've built
with 3D foot scanning, especially getting mobile reconstruction accurate
enough to drive fit recommendations at scale.

I'm reaching out [SENDER]. We work with ML teams building on 3D and
multimodal sensor data, and a few things we've shipped recently seem
directly relevant to what your team is likely dealing with:

   - *3D/point cloud annotation* - cuboid labeling, segmentation, and
   sensor fusion for depth + RGB data (overview here
   <[LINK]>
   )
   - *Keypoint & pose annotation* - skeleton-based landmark labeling for
   training measurement extraction models (guide
   <[LINK]>
   )
   - *Data curation at scale* - automatically surfacing low-quality or
   redundant training samples, which matters a lot when you're ingesting scan
   data across thousands of retail locations (Standard AI case study
   <[LINK]>
   )

Happy to show you how other CV teams are using Encord to tighten up their
data pipelines. Would a 20-minute call be worth it?

text:

on ADAS annotation pipelines
